```{r}
pipelines <- read.csv("data/pipelines.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
taxa <- read.csv("data/taxa_matrix.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
source("R/taxon_score.R")
coverage <- merge(
  taxa,
  pipelines[, c("pipeline_id", "name")],
  by = "pipeline_id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)
coverage <- score_taxa(coverage)
coverage <- coverage[, c(
  "name", "intended_scope", "score", "bacteria", "archaea", "viruses", "fungi",
  "plants", "animals", "protists", "capability_note"
)]
names(coverage) <- c(
  "Pipeline", "Intended scope", "Score", "Bacteria", "Archaea", "Viruses",
  "Fungi", "Plants", "Animals", "Protists", "Notes"
)
```


```{r}
DT::datatable(
  coverage,
  elementId = "taxa-catalogue",
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  class = "compact stripe taxa-table",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 100,
    lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
    scrollX = FALSE,
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    order = list(list(2, "desc")),
    dom = '<"taxa-table-search"f>rt<"taxa-table-footer"lip>',
    columnDefs = list(
      list(width = "8%", targets = 0),
      list(width = "16%", targets = 1),
      list(width = "6%", targets = 2),
      list(width = "6%", targets = 3:9),
      list(width = "28%", targets = 10)
    )
  )
) |>
  DT::formatStyle(
    c("Bacteria", "Archaea", "Viruses", "Fungi", "Plants", "Animals", "Protists"),
    backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(c("Y", "DB", "~", "—"), c("#d5eee7", "#e7edf4", "#f6e8c8", "#f1f1ef"))
  ) |>
  DT::formatStyle(
    "Score",
    color = "transparent",
    background = DT::styleColorBar(c(0, 1), "#8bb7a8", angle = 270),
    backgroundSize = "100% 12px",
    backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
    backgroundPosition = "left center"
  )
```

The colored score bar is a relative breadth metric, not a quality/performance score; the numeric value is retained for sorting but hidden. Scores range from 0 to 1. For each of seven groups, intended support earns 2 points (`Y`), 1.25 (`~`), or 1 (`DB`); supported but non-intended `Y`, `~`, and `DB` earn 1, 0.5, and 0.25 points respectively. The total is normalized by the maximum of 14. `Y` means supported, `DB` means database-dependent, `~` means partial/optional, and `—` means no documented support.

Scope and notes text is clipped to keep all rows the same height; full text is available in the editable CSV and detailed review.

This matrix intentionally avoids interpreting an arbitrary match in a broad nt/nr reference as validated organism identification. Genome-resolved workflows report taxonomy for recovered contigs or MAGs, while read-profiling workflows report read-level assignments; those outputs should not be treated as interchangeable.

[Download the editable taxon matrix](data/taxa_matrix.csv) · [Review the inclusion boundaries](index.qmd#inclusion-criteria)
